fit_note: Singleton: SFT of a code VLM on unverified video-to-code data from frontier models; no harness teacher, no success filter.
LLM writes a two-level Prolog KB checked by consistency predicates with failure feedback; BFS plan, OR-Tools schedule, behaviour tree; human repairs KBs.
Fine-tuned high-level VLM emits atomic language commands and replies to a trained pi0 VLA; trained on human skill labels plus back-generated prompts.
Variant: the LLM writes symbolic search/solver code plus checker code, run for up to 3 rounds; plan computed by executed code over full text state.
VLM points at targets in one aerial image, scaled to metres for NMPC; no feasibility check or reselection loop.
Singleton: GPT-4 writes reward and success-classifier code once, SAC trains on privileged state; no revision from traces, no LLM-policy RL.
UAV LLM picks from an action set plus waypoints; system paper, LLM motion stage never flight-tested, no success metric (screening doubt).
Trained waypoint predictor proposes candidates each step; frozen GPT-4o picks one from candidate images and history, with an explicit move-back option.
Trained VLM Connector grounds the frozen planner's skill commands into closed-loop navigation and pose adjustment before trained skills: a trained typed-call layer.
Reflections from earlier iterations of the same task feed the next initial plan; VLM pre/post-condition checks gate subtasks.
LLM agents write deployable multi-robot code policies, check them statically and in simulation, revise from VLM critique of rollout video, then auto-deploy.
Frozen VLM captions the egocentric frame to text for a frozen LLM planner over a humanoid action library; staged reasoning prompt is the contribution.
Fine-tuned motion-prediction MLLM plus fine-tuned correction MLLM issue motion instructions to a motion-conditioned diffusion policy; human correction data.
Fine-tuned TinyLlama maps instructions to discrete UAV actions; no frozen-model interface studied; 15 episodes per scene.
Singleton: RAG over past dialogue for history questions; offline plan/QA accuracy, not control (screening doubt).
Trained brain MLLM (3-stage, LLM-generated planning data) emits subtask DAGs and tool calls over pre-trained skills for several robots; offline accuracy only.
Topological graph of prior successful trajectories searched instead of online planning, but hierarchical LLM planning is the main contribution.
CodeAgent calls VLM tools for UAV mission planning over image crops; no embodied dynamics (screening doubt).
Connectors and langchain tools expose ROS 2 navigation, MoveIt, detection and depth queries to LLM agents; RAG embodiment store; qualitative only.
Harness builds semantic, cognitive and uncertainty maps from depth and writes gated exploitation/exploration advice into the MLLM's action prompt.
Singleton: teacher SFT then GRPO with an offline prefix-match reward against gold actions; no environment rollouts in RL.
Turn/Move vocabulary executed by PX4 with a VLM detector; a model-pair benchmark rather than an interface study.
Sample N VLA actions, Gaussian-perturb, score with a LoRA-trained VLM reward model, execute the argmax.
Teacher-free GRPO on sparse completion fits, but text-only ALFWorld/ScienceWorld, not an embodied code harness.
Per-UAV LLM target proposals, learned role selection and an LLM consensus round; small LLMs LoRA-tuned on filtered GPT-4o samples.
Wet-lab multi-agent pipeline; generator-checker stages and a runtime VLM abort gate resemble K201/K202 only in part.
LLM subgoal code run 10 times per round; symbolic logs plus VLM checkpoint judgement diagnose failures and drive code edits.
Abstract only: one trained VLM as high level over a low-level controller (CPT, SFT, RL); mechanism matches R02 but cannot be checked in full text.
Frozen LLM with simulator poses annotates and retargets a demo; executed successes kept as IL demonstrations; selection by Thompson sampling, not failure-log revision.
Centralized LLM writes multi-step action chains per agent; rule validator flags precondition and same-object conflicts; LLM repairs flagged chains.
Trained orchestrator VLM decomposes tasks and calls a trained thinking VLA by language; full text truncated after Sec 3.1, results figure-only.
VLM writes SMT constraints for a TAMP task planner from image and geometry text and revises them after planner or refinement failures.
Four-agent assistive planning on one static image; nothing executed, outputs ranked by judges (screening doubt).
Task-manager LLM classifies and allocates tasks across robots; perception events filtered by an LLM trigger replanning of unfinished tasks.
MCP tools generated from ROS message schemas plus VLA backend swapping behind a fixed I/O contract; agent-level success not measured.
Training-free static affordance pipeline (image editing, VLM, detector+SAM); no control loop (screening doubt).
LLM decomposes and allocates into per-subtask PDDL problems solved by Fast Downward, merged and compiled into parallel behaviour trees; ground-truth domain.
Frozen LLM emits a global waypoint path; an RL local policy trained with a waypoint-adherence reward is the typed-call follower; table numbers absent in text.
Sample K CoT action candidates and pick the one passing most same-model true/false and masked-entity verifications.
Ten LLMs swapped under a fixed manipulation harness and two executor modes (code vs tool calls) per model; success scored by LLM judges, not execution.
Singleton: trainable write-time memory gate for a frozen MLLM; no cluster partner (policy routing is a different mechanism).
Real-time LM calls optional attention and perception tools while acting; tool-removal ablation; 24 videos, no task-success metric.
Trained pointer, depth back-projection and LLM 3D path with a classical executor, plus lesson bank and BC distillation; no reselect loop.
LLM agents form dynamic groups, negotiate subgroup plans and get executor-LLM feasibility feedback for heterogeneous robots; SR 0.200 without feedback.
Forum-to-robot system with MCP tools over quadruped/humanoid primitives; no quantitative evaluation (screening doubt).
Best-of-N plans scored by an internal reflector plus hindsight reflection and test-time training of policy and critic.
Hierarchical LLM agents write small PDDL problems solved and validated by Fast Downward; failures drive prompt optimisation; full observability.
KV-cache serving for embodied memory prompts; latency only, not a harness mechanism (screening doubt).
LLM-written behaviour tree with VLM condition nodes and retries; main contribution is the expert-agent clarification cascade; no measured end-to-end success.
LLM builds an operation/precedence graph solved by a disjunctive-graph scheduler, then programs over skills; LLM-ordered variant without the solver reaches SR 0.00.
Coding agent rewrites the controller class between episodes from key frames, phase logs and its own source; no model in the loop at run time.
Singleton: VLM-inferred safety predicates compiled into a CBF filter on a nominal controller; a runtime safety filter, not a proposal gate.
Per-camera VLM monitors answer the controller's text queries; text-only LLM controller with a curator-maintained bounded memory.
Singleton: retrieve past execution records to route among frozen policies; unit is policy selection, not notes.
Variant: backward search over the PDDL domain's action graph prunes actions and objects before LLM decomposition and allocation; no problem file or solver.
VLM agent starts, switches and monitors LoRA-tuned VLA skills and reset policies through MCP tools; self-resetting collection and deployment recovery.
SFT on synthesized CoT then success-reward GRPO fits, but the headline is a trained zoom-in perception tool; no tool-vs-CoT ablation.
Harness builds a depth BEV map and at most 4 frontiers; the VLM ranks them (blended with a UCB value map) and FMM drives.
Direct contrast of a narrow explicit SmolAgents tool vs MCP discovery among 39 generic ROS services for the same action; false completions under MCP.
12 frozen models x 8 harness tiers (abstraction, multi-turn feedback, visual differencing) on 7 tasks x 100 trials.
